title: Disputes Desk Basis: Correction of Utility Bill Lines, the Dispute Window and Grounds for Credit
content:
# Correction of Utility Bill Lines — Utility Services Program

## D1. Only through a dispute

A utility bill line is corrected only through a dispute recorded against that line, except an estimated-read true-up, which follows automatically from the next actual read. The dispute is read from the system's dispute record, which names the bill line disputed.

## D2. Dispute window

A dispute may be accepted only when the current date is no later than the bill date of the disputed line plus the program's dispute window. Dispute days are counted as calendar days starting the day after the bill date, and the last counted day is included. The bill date is taken from the system record of the disputed line.

| Current date, counted in calendar days after the bill date | Dispute may be accepted? |
|---|---|
| any day up to and including the last day of the window | yes, as far as the window is concerned |
| the day after the last day of the window | no |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical 60-day window, bill date March 12):* day 1 is March 13, and day 60 is May 11. On May 11 the window condition is met; on May 12 it is not.

## D3. Decision time

Disputes are decided within the program's dispute response period, counted in business days (Monday to Friday, federal holidays excluded).

## D4. Grounds of credit

- **Leak adjustment.** A leak adjustment requires that the leak was inside the apartment home and was repaired by a maintenance work order completed within the program's leak repair period after the bill date. Allocation programs have no leak adjustment, because an allocation does not measure the apartment home's own use.
- **Occupancy correction.** An occupancy correction credits the difference when a line was billed on a billed-occupants figure other than the one in force for that period.
- **Billing error.** A billing error credits the part of a line computed against the Utility Services Program's charter.
- **Meter accuracy.** A meter accuracy dispute is decided by a meter test. When the meter over-registers by more than the program's accuracy tolerance, the usage lines since the last accurate test, at most the lines still within the dispute window, are re-billed by crediting the over-registered share; otherwise the meter test fee is charged and no credit is made.

## D5. Once per reason

Each bill line is credited at most once per reason, as the system's record of adjustments against that line shows; the limit is counted separately for each reason.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following parts of the leak adjustment clause have been superseded and are **no longer in force**:

1. That a leak adjustment is granted when the disputed usage line's usage is at least the program's leak multiple times the average usage of the service.
2. That a leak adjustment requires the count of leak adjustments on the account within the trailing 365 days to be below the program's annual limit.
3. That a leak adjustment credits the program's leak credit share of the charge for the usage above the average usage, rounded half up to the cent.
